# Lazurny audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/lazurny-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set lazurny` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `wind.mp3` is cut from "SFX-Windy,Whistle,Indoors,Creaks" by soundandmelodies, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/soundandmelodies/sounds/831617/.
- `crows.mp3` is cut from "Crows" by Dave_Girtsman, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Dave_Girtsman/sounds/353432/.
